scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。 本期说明：去重后精选 6 篇；均由网页补充获得，来源多样性未达标；其中 2 篇为 90 天窗口内的较早研究。

papers.title: DoPR: Reusable Compressed Document Prefixes for Efficient LLM Reranking
papers.authors: Dai, Beiya, Wei, Yifan, Yang, Guang, Shi, Xing, Wang, Xinbing, Lin, Zhouhan
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are effective rerankers, but pointwise reranking repeatedly processes the same document across different queries, causing substantial redundant document-side computation. We propose \textbf{DoPR}, a compressed document prefix framework that decouples offline document processing from online reranking. DoPR first selects query-independent document representations and converts them into compressed document prefix states, which are precomputed offline and reused whenever the document is retrieved. During online reranking, the model scores each query-document pair by processing only the query and scoring token, with document information supplied by the stored prefix states. This design reduces online cost through both document-side compression and cross-query prefix-state reuse. Experiments on TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT with Qwen3 models from $0.6$B to $8$B show that DoPR achieves up to 8.0$\times$ online document-side memory reduction and up to 8.04$\times$ latency speedup, while retaining \textbf{97.1\%-99.5\%} of the average NDCG@10 of matched full-document rerankers.
papers.summary: 针对同一文档被不同查询反复编码的开销，DoPR 离线选择显著 token，将其转换为可复用的多层前缀状态，在线仅处理查询与评分 token。在 TREC DL、BEIR 和 BRIGHT 上，0.6B 至 8B 模型保留对应完整重排器平均 nDCG@10 的 97.1%–99.5%；长文档 Covid 设置最高加速 8.04 倍，短文档 DL19 为 1.21–1.84 倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可先在重复访问较多的帖子上试验文档前缀缓存，以较小相关性损失换取重排预算。关键是训练时限制查询只能通过压缩表示读取文档，并重新生成前缀 KV 状态；直接截取原文 KV 缓存并不等价。收益取决于帖子长度、复用次数和更新频率，需连同离线预计算、存储读取和缓存失效成本一起评估。
papers.score_reason: 文档重排直接服务社区搜索 nDCG；跨模型、跨数据集和消融充分，代码已公开，但缓存工程与增量更新仍需适配。

papers.title: From Topical Relevance to Answerability: Entailment Distillation for Conversational Retrieval
papers.authors: Qin, Shuai, An, Guojia, Guo, Weikang, Ke, Pei, Wei, Jiwei, Yang, Yang, Zou, Jie
papers.abstract: Existing conversational retrievers commonly treat topical relevance as a proxy for answerability. However, a passage that closely matches the dialogue context is not necessarily the one that supports the correct answer. We identify this mismatch as a systematic answerability gap. To address this issue, we propose CLEAR, a framework that shifts conversational retrieval from topical relevance to answerability. The core of CLEAR is entailment distillation, which transfers answer-passage entailment supervision into a cross-encoder reranker so that the reranker discriminates answer-supporting passages from topical distractors at inference time, without requiring answers. CLEAR is complemented by a passage-centric abductive recall module that brings low-similarity yet answerable passages into the candidate pool by inferring answerable queries from passages with an LLM. Across TopiOCQA, QReCC, and out-of-domain TREC CAsT datasets, CLEAR consistently improves top-ranked precision over strong query-rewriting and dense-retrieval baselines, with the largest gains observed in conversations involving heavier topical noise. Moreover, applying our reranker on top of an LLM-driven query rewriter yields further gains.
papers.summary: CLEAR 解决对话检索中主题相近却无法回答当前问题的错配：把答案与段落的蕴含监督蒸馏给重排器，并离线生成段落可回答的查询补充召回。同一 RRF 候选池上，TopiOCQA 的 MRR 从普通交叉编码器的 31.2 升至 46.2，QReCC 从 68.2 升至 69.3；单 A6000 测得总在线时延为 171.9 毫秒。
papers.key_insight: 对社区问答搜索，可把“话题相关”和“支持答案”拆成不同监督目标，减少旧话题与相似讨论占据前排。优先用已有优质问答构建答案—帖子蕴含训练对，再评估是否值得增加离线查询索引。论文在 TopiOCQA 上仍弱于 ConvSearch-R1 的 48.9 MRR，说明这类重排与查询改写应组合评测，不能据此宣称全面领先。
papers.score_reason: 对话和问答检索相关性很高；需要答案监督、离线查询生成及额外索引，工程门槛高于直接替换重排模型。

papers.title: CORE: Improving Compositional Reasoning in MLLM Embedding via Reranker Distillation
papers.authors: Song, Tingyu, Li, Mingxin, Zhang, Yanzhao, Long, Dingkun, Liu, Chu, Xie, Pengjun, Zhao, Yilun, Wu, Shu
papers.abstract: MLLM-based embedding models remain limited in compositional retrieval, often failing to distinguish scenes containing the same concepts but different attribute-object bindings. Yet the same backbone can resolve such distinctions when used as a cross-attentive reranker, motivating us to distill its compositional judgments into the embedding model. We propose CORE, which synthesizes candidate lists spanning five compositional matching levels and introduces a Rank-KL objective that trains the embedding model to reproduce the reranker's fine-grained ranking. We further introduce a graded evaluation protocol and compare contrastive learning, pairwise CoSENT, and listwise Rank-KL under the same data and tuning budget. Our comparison shows that both CoSENT and Rank-KL use the multi-level supervision more effectively than contrastive learning, with Rank-KL achieving the strongest overall performance. Across three compositional reasoning benchmarks (COLA, SUGARCREPE++, NEGBENCH), CORE-RERANKER-8B achieves an 82.7% total average, outperforming Jina-Reranker by 10.7 points, while CORE-EMBED-8B achieves the best total average (0.666) among all evaluated embedding models. The improvements transfer to the MCMR benchmark without sacrificing retrieval performance on COCO and Flickr30K.
papers.summary: CORE 针对多模态向量难以分辨属性、对象和关系组合的问题，合成五级匹配候选，并用 Rank-KL 将交叉注意力重排器的细粒度排序蒸馏给向量模型。在三个组合推理基准上，8B 重排器总平均准确率为 82.7%，比 Jina-Reranker 高 10.7 个百分点；8B 向量模型总平均为 0.666，并保持 COCO 与 Flickr30K 检索表现。
papers.key_insight: 图文社区搜索可借鉴五级难例构造，把对象正确但属性或关系错误的帖子作为分级负例，训练召回模型理解复合意图。采用教师候选分布比单个正负标签保留更多排序信息，但论文的向量模型收益明显小于教师收益。落地时应分别监测图文 nDCG、属性绑定错误和通用召回，避免把合成验证集上的改善直接解释为真实用户收益。
papers.score_reason: 组合语义匹配适用于图文 UGC，已有明确蒸馏流程及多基准实验；与纯文本短查询场景仍有迁移距离。

papers.title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval
papers.authors: Zhou, Gang, Yu, Xiongxi, Tian, Hu, Wei, Yang, Pan, Lu, Zeng, Ke, Xu, Shibiao, Zheng, Xiaolong
papers.abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval requires text representations to capture not only semantic similarity, but also the reasoning needed to determine relevance under a given retrieval instruction. Existing reasoning-enhanced embedding models improve retrieval by incorporating reasoning information into dense representations, yet their supervision is typically dominated by the final retrieval objective. As a result, latent reasoning trajectories may learn shortcut reasoning patterns that preserve retrieval performance without producing meaningful incremental retrieval gains. We propose Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning (RGLT), a latent reasoning framework for dense retrieval that explicitly connects intermediate latent transitions with retrieval improvements. RGLT performs non-autoregressive reasoning in hidden space through an instruction-conditioned latent reasoning trajectory constructed from silent tokens. It combines process-supervised explicit-to-implicit distillation with retrieval-grounded supervision, using stage-wise CoT reconstruction to shape intermediate latent states and retrieval-effect credit to optimize incremental retrieval gains across the latent reasoning trajectories. Experiments on reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks show that RGLT consistently outperforms strong baselines while preserving efficient embedding inference.
papers.summary: RGLT 将检索收益监督施加到潜在推理的中间阶段，用 16 个静默 token 形成四段查询表征，推理时直接输出单向量而不生成文字思维链。BRIGHT 的 nDCG@10 达到 34.20、Recall@10 为 39.97，较 LaSER 分别相对提高 14.4% 和 16.6%；单 A100 的查询延迟为 24.0 毫秒，对照基础检索器为 21.5 毫秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区复杂意图检索可以尝试把推理能力压入查询向量，保留现有单向量近邻召回接口。更有价值的设计是监督每段潜在状态带来的相关文档排序变化，而非仅要求隐状态相似；去掉末段相对基础表示的优势约束后，nDCG 从 34.20 降至 26.39。训练使用 32 张 A100，实际试验前需评估算力投入及领域数据迁移。
papers.score_reason: 核心仍是稠密检索表征而非搜索智能体；离线效果和效率有明确证据，但训练资源较重，发表已超过 7 天。

papers.title: Comparing Retrieval Methods for Academic Advisor Discovery: A Six-Method Study of 768 CS Faculty Profiles Across 9 US Universities
papers.abstract: We present a comparative evaluation of six information retrieval methods for the task of academic advisor discovery: ranking CS faculty members by relevance to a graduate applicant's research interest statement. The methods span sparse lexical matching (Jaccard overlap, TF-IDF, BM25), dense semantic retrieval (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings), hybrid score fusion, and learning-to-rank. Evaluation uses a new domain-specific collection: 768 faculty profiles scraped from 9 US CS departments, with 162 graded relevance judgments (grade 0/1/2) across 5 queries representing distinct graduate student research profiles. Across all five queries, Reranked achieves the highest mean NDCG@10 (0.477, std 0.138), followed by Semantic (0.450), Hybrid (0.421), BM25 (0.406), Jaccard (0.303), and TF-IDF (0.246). After Bonferroni correction across all 15 pairwise comparisons, TF-IDF is significantly worse than BM25, Semantic, Hybrid, and Reranked; no other pairwise difference survives correction at 5 queries. A field ablation reveals that biography alone (NDCG 0.634) outperforms the full model combining biography with research area tags (0.593). A controlled experiment shows that concatenating arXiv paper abstracts reduces NDCG@10 by 0.176, motivating a late-fusion architecture. All code, scrapers, and relevance labels are released openly.
papers.summary: 该研究比较词法、向量、混合融合和学习排序六种方法，用于按研究兴趣检索导师，数据包含 9 所美国高校的 768 份资料及 5 个查询的 162 条分级标注。重排平均 nDCG@10 为 0.477，语义检索为 0.450，BM25 为 0.406；15 组比较经 Bonferroni 校正后，多数组间差异不显著，不能据均值断言重排稳定优于向量检索。
papers.key_insight: 社区用户、话题或帖子搜索可借鉴其字段消融：直接拼接论文摘要使 nDCG@10 下降 0.176，提示丰富文本也可能稀释匹配信号。应先比较短简介、标签和正文的独立贡献，再测试后融合，避免盲目加长输入。由于仅有 5 个查询，文中数值适合作为排查线索；上线决策仍需扩大查询集并按长尾意图分层验证。
papers.score_reason: 小规模实体检索可直接复现，但创新主要在应用比较，5 个查询不足以支持广泛结论，证据维度降分。

papers.title: CHSR-RRF: A curriculum-gated hybrid retrieval framework with reciprocal rank fusion and leakage-aware benchmarking for educational RAG
papers.authors: Ateya, Terence, Ndum, Zavier Ndum, Fu, Jicheng, Tendongkeng, Kelly
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly used in educational question answering, but standard retrievers optimize topical relevance without enforcing curriculum validity. In school settings, a passage can be relevant yet inappropriate if it comes from the wrong subject, level, or examination context; we call this failure mode curriculum leakage. We present CHSR-RRF, a curriculum-gated hybrid retrieval framework that applies metadata constraints before retrieval, then combines sparse and dense search with reciprocal rank fusion and deterministic reranking. We also introduce CERB, a 126-case benchmark for curriculum-constrained retrieval with hierarchy-aware relevance labels and explicit leakage annotations. On a 61-case pilot, pre-retrieval gating reduces leakage by 4.6x ($p<0.001$) while preserving ranked recall, whereas applying the same constraints after retrieval collapses recall and exact-scope success to zero ($p=0.039$). A full-benchmark lower-bound analysis further shows that many remaining failures arise from corpus and metadata gaps rather than retrieval design alone. These results show that retrieval in structured educational domains should be treated as constrained selection, with validity enforced when the candidate pool is formed rather than after ranking.
papers.summary: CHSR-RRF 在检索前用课程、级别等元数据限定有效候选，再融合稀疏与稠密召回并确定性重排，处理“主题相关但适用范围错误”的问题。CERB 共 126 个案例，其中 61 例试验显示前置过滤将范围泄漏降低 4.6 倍；将同样条件移到召回之后过滤，召回率和精确范围成功率均降为零，完整基准还暴露了语料覆盖缺口。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索中的版块、语言、地区和内容权限同样属于候选有效性条件，可先验证前置约束是否比 Top-K 后过滤保留更多可用结果。论文采用小型教育基准，不能把其 4.6 倍收益直接迁移到 UGC；应把漏召回拆解为检索算法、元数据缺失和语料缺失三类。原文标示日期为 7 月 14 日，本期按 90 天补充窗口纳入。
papers.score_reason: 约束检索设计容易迁移到社区分区和范围筛选；方法是已有组件组合，试验规模小且发表较早。
